summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new Settings/Drive/WhatsApp feature set on the Product Drive PHP CMS. 36/36 UI checks PASSED. Verified admin-only visibility of nav-settings (operator hidden + /settings redirects to /dashboard), all three panels render (drive-settings-panel, whatsapp-settings-panel, general-settings-panel) plus the read-only wa-webhook-url. Drive form persists (toggle + folder id survive reload, status badge flips to 'Enabled'). Drive 'Test connection' with no service-account JSON returns a clean red flash ('Invalid service account JSON (missing client_email / private_key).') and does NOT crash. Drive 'Sync local files' with Drive disabled returns a graceful warning flash ('Enable and configure Google Drive first.') and does not crash. WhatsApp form persists Phone Number ID, Verify Token, Graph version, and Access Token secret; after reload the wa-token-input value is empty and the placeholder is masked ('••••••••••••ALUE  (leave blank to keep)'); the raw secret 'EAABTESTTOKEN123SECRETVALUE' does NOT appear anywhere in the returned HTML. Saving the WA form again with the token field left BLANK correctly retains the previously saved secret (placeholder still masked). General app_url persists. CSRF is enforced — POST /settings/drive and POST /settings/whatsapp without _csrf both return HTTP 419. Core regression check passes: with Drive DISABLED, creating a product with an image works (local fallback), the product appears in the list with a thumbnail, and editing the product persists changes. Dashboard, products search, categories, users, profile, and logout all still work. Drive & WhatsApp toggles were left DISABLED at end of run per instructions. Test product was created ('TEST Regression Product EDITED') and then deleted via UI cleanup at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.php _save_secret() correctly keeps existing secrets on blank submit — verified end-to-end. Good.

wa-token-input uses masked placeholder (setting_mask) and the input value is intentionally empty on GET, so the plaintext token is never re-rendered. Verified the raw token string is absent from HTML source. Good.
CSRF middleware returns 419 as expected on both /settings/drive and /settings/whatsapp — matches project convention.
Product creation gracefully falls back to local storage when drive_enabled=0; no drive_upload attempt observed in the create flow. Regression path is intact.

Minor UX suggestion (not a bug): the Drive 'Sync local files' button label shows a pending count '(N)' — when Drive is disabled the click still shows only the 'Enable and configure Google Drive first.' warning without acting on the counter. This is correct behavior; no change needed.
test_credentials: admin@productdrive.test / admin123 and operator@productdrive.test / operator123 — both verified working. /app/memory/test_credentials.md was not read this run (PHP app, no bcrypt/CORS/cookie auth flows to inspect).
seed_data_creation: One test product created for regression check ('TEST Regression Product' -> renamed 'TEST Regression Product EDITED'), then deleted via UI. Settings values touched during tests were reset at end: Drive toggle=OFF, folder_id cleared, WhatsApp toggle=OFF. Persisted secrets in settings table (wa_access_token, wa_app_secret if entered) remain in DB masked as designed — safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PHP app served by supervisor 'frontend' program (PHP built-in on :3000) via /app/pdcms/router.php. Correct login testids are login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn. Settings testids match spec exactly. To exercise real Google Drive / WhatsApp API you need valid service-account JSON + Meta Cloud API token in the Settings UI — not exercised here per user instruction. Webhook GET verify + POST HMAC signature paths were already validated by main agent via curl and are not covered by this UI-only pass.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. All 12 requested feature checks and regression flows passed.
